summary: Iter-24 verified the new per-batch SRN/ERN slice mechanism. New 10-test suite covering TC1-TC9 + TC11 (TC10 = regression run) all PASS (10/10). Discovered ONE bug: response_model on POST/PUT slice endpoints strips the children[] field from the response payload (data is correctly persisted; GET re-fetch returns it). Iter-21 (5/17 fail) and iter-23 (2/5 fail) regressions have EXPECTED breakages because the legacy PUT /short-received-notes/{id} endpoint writes fulfilled_qty directly on PARENT items, but the new _compute_srn_status/_compute_ern_status helpers only count children[]. These legacy paths are now stuck at PENDING — main agent should either deprecate the legacy PUT endpoints or update them to spawn children too.

minor.issue: response_model=ShortReceivedNote/ExtraReceivedNote strips items[].children from the JSON response because ShortReceivedNoteItem/ExtraReceivedNoteItem Pydantic models (server.py lines 387 & 445) do NOT declare a `children` field. Data IS persisted in MongoDB and is returned correctly by the GET endpoints. Frontend code that relies on the immediate POST/PUT response to refresh slice list will see an empty children[] until it re-fetches via GET. Fix: add `children: Optional[List[dict]] = []` to ShortReceivedNoteItem and ExtraReceivedNoteItem.

Legacy PUT writes fulfilled_qty / accepted_qty directly onto parent items but the new _compute_srn_status / _compute_ern_status helpers only sum children[]. Result: parent SRN/ERN status remains PENDING even when fulfilled_qty/accepted_qty is set on parent items — breaking iter-21 SRN/ERN status tests and iter-23 TC2/TC3. Also breaks finalize-with-residual auto-spawn (legacy SRN.finalize uses fulfilled_qty on parent, status no longer transitions to PARTIALLY_RECEIVED/COMPLETE). Either remove these legacy endpoints (frontend now uses /fulfill, /accept) or migrate them to spawn children too.

action_items: Add `children: Optional[List[dict]] = []` to ShortReceivedNoteItem (server.py line 387) and ExtraReceivedNoteItem (line 445) so POST /fulfill, /accept, PUT /children/{cid}, /reject responses include the children array. Frontend can then update slice tables from the mutation response without an extra GET round-trip.

Decide on legacy PUT /api/short-received-notes/{id} and /api/extra-received-notes/{id} (and their /finalize counterparts): either remove them (review_request notes 'Frontend will use the new slice endpoints exclusively') or rewrite them to push to children[] so the new status helpers work. Currently they no longer transition status from PENDING.

Update or delete legacy iter-21 tests (test_iter21_status_workflow.py — TestSRNFlow.test_partial_fulfillment_marks_srn_partially_received, test_full_fulfillment_marks_complete_not_legacy_label, test_finalize_partial_keeps_partially_received_and_spawns_child; TestERNFlow.test_partial_accept_marks_partially_accepted, test_fully_decided_ern_marks_complete) and iter-23 (TestTC2ChildSrnTracking, TestTC3ChildErnTracking) since they exercise the deprecated legacy PUT contract.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG: Pydantic models ShortReceivedNoteItem & ExtraReceivedNoteItem missing `children` field — silently strips data from POST/PUT mutation responses (lines 387-406 and 445-462 in server.py).

Legacy PUT /api/short-received-notes/{id} and PUT /api/extra-received-notes/{id} write fulfilled_qty/accepted_qty on parent items but new _compute_srn_status / _compute_ern_status only consider children[] sum — orphaned code path that will silently no-op the status workflow.

_create_child_srn_for_slice / _create_child_ern_for_slice correctly stamp parent_srn_id / parent_ern_id and propagate parent_rn_id; child status hard-coded to COMPLETE and racking_status RACKING_PENDING — immediately rackable, matches spec.

Validation guards present: /fulfill rejects qty > short_qty - already, /accept rejects qty > extra - rejected - accepted_so_far, /reject rejects rejected > extra - accepted_so_far, /children edit rejects exceeds short - others, /children edit/delete rejects when an RKN exists against the child (409). All five guards verified by tests.
Status helper (_compute_srn_status / _compute_ern_status) correctly returns parent's stored status for child docs (parent_srn_id/parent_ern_id set) and recomputes parent from children[].
Racking sources endpoint /api/racking-notes/sources correctly filters parent SRN/ERN out (no fulfilled_qty / accepted_qty on parent items) and surfaces only children — verified by TC11.

success_rate.backend: 100% on new slice flow (10/10 TC1-TC9 + TC11). 12/17 iter-21 regression. 3/5 iter-23 regression. The 5 + 2 failures are EXPECTED migration breakages of legacy PUT endpoints.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (Pydantic stripping bug): FastAPI's response_model coercion drops fields not declared on the Pydantic model. Since ShortReceivedNoteItem/ExtraReceivedNoteItem don't declare `children`, the serializer drops the array during response serialization. Reproduction: POST /api/short-received-notes/{id}/fulfill returns item without `children` key; immediate GET on same id returns item WITH `children` populated. Mitigation: add `children: Optional[List[dict]] = []` to both item models. ROOT CAUSE (legacy PUT migration): _compute_srn_status / _compute_ern_status were rewritten to derive status purely from children[] sum, but the legacy PUT endpoint still mutates parent items[].fulfilled_qty without ever pushing to children[]. The legacy paths now silently keep parent at PENDING.
